messages:
alexa_cs: Heads-up: small customer (BrightLoop) flagged unexpected token surge during onboarding demos. Adding to QBR risks if we don't triage quickly. Can finops and enablement look? :lighthouse:

mike_finops: Share 7d vs prior 7d and top routes pls so we can recommend quota vs credit.

alexa_cs: Quick numbers: 7d tokens =~ 420k (prior 48k) -> ~8.8x; est monthly delta ~$9.5k; top routes: /demo/chat (62%), /embed/preview (28%), scheduled-tests (10%); no account-level budget alerts.

cost-bot: Alert: BrightLoop usage exceeds baseline. Suggest adding temporary per-route caps and an alert at 50% consumption.

tess_onboard: Likely demo harness pointed at prod endpoint. I'll draft a short note with sandboxing + batching code and a suggested remediation window.

oliver_success: Playbook: 1) apply soft per-route cap to demo/chat (10rps), 2) outreach with snippet + ask them to switch to sandbox for demos, 3) add QBR slide with cost impact and proposed one-time credit if needed. 30m sync with customer?

mike_finops: Applied cap demo/chat=10rps and created alert. Estimated immediate monthly savings ~ $6.7k. Will keep cap for 72h while we engage. Can offer a short credit if they lose demo capacity.

alexa_cs: Thx — I'll add the cost delta and actions to the QBR deck and mark account risk=medium. Tess, pls send enablement note and snippet before the sync.

tess_onboard: Sending enablement note now (short snippet: use sandbox env + batch previews 200-300 items).

cost-bot: Temp cap applied on route demo/chat=10rps. Monitoring enabled for throttles and alerts.
